review_basis: Report text as supplied to the model (report-json-input/4), the selected element statements, the formal plan, the compiled P/I/V and the six SMT query statuses. The reviewer is the same assistant that authored the v3.18-v3.20 prompt changes and is therefore not independent; no gold_v1 approval was used or required.

ratings.reason: Elements are faithful (I = _endRewards() should execute when totalFeeShare = 0 and unlocked = false; V = _endRewards() may not trigger). The plan selected the first-purchase branch and omitted the separate totalFeeShare = 0 numeric P source: attempt 1 raised 'numeric P source missing from plan' and both field-scoped local repairs returned no change. Same defect as the v3.16 review.

Element layer is correct (I = operator_should_not_fund_campaign; V = bob_funds_campaign). The formula then seeded the obligation's condition with the P fact creator_internal_balance >= campaign_amount (source alice_deposits_1000_usdc). The report's attack works precisely because that comparison is false at execution (0 >= 1000), so the condition excludes the attack state: I is vacuously true there and V cannot co-occur with the attack. P also asserts the negated comparison. Semantically identical to the v3.16 fail/fail/fail verdict on this case; the duplicate-P collapse and the missing coverage that v3.16 also reported were fixed, while I lost the numeric amounts (operator_paid_amount = 0 and creator_funded_amount = campaign_amount) and became a single Boolean.

Condition is exactly the four report facts (77-byte format, validity data outside the digest, recovery over userOpHash alone, attacker rewrites the suffix); I = the signer's window must be bound to the signature; V = AtomWallet accepts the signature with the attacker-controlled window. All three faithful. The v3.16 false rejection (numeric-P guard misreading ERC-4337/EIP-191) no longer occurs.

The readiness call returned malformed JSON (1178 chars, completion_tokens 350) against a byte-identical prompt to the frozen run (sha256 2aefda02...) where the same call returned 1403 chars and parsed. The input-sufficiency call has no retry, so one malformed response is a hard pipeline failure with 1 invocation. Reproduced on the diagnostic re-run (char 1184). This is a sampling/transport failure, not a prompt regression, and is reported separately rather than as an abstention.

P is exactly the four facts the attack requires to be true (assets invested, main vault balance zero, users hold shares, invested assets tracked); none is negated by the attack. I = unregisterVault() must not succeed with outstanding shares or invested assets; V = it succeeds. All three faithful. access_control is a loose taxonomy label, the relation itself is faithful. Same verdict as v3.16.

summary.tautology_note: For relation_obligation encodings the compiled V is condition and not(I's consequent), so P and V and I is unsatisfiable by construction. strict_piv_gate = true therefore carries no information about report fidelity for these cases.
summary.interpretation: Single-shot measurement on the same five frozen reports used for the v3.16 holdout. Assistant artifact review, not expert gold, not population accuracy.
